scenarios.title: 玩家進入排行榜看到預設榜單
scenarios.gherkin_zh:
Given 玩家已登入大廳
When 玩家點擊排行榜入口
Then 顯示『個人 / 下注金額 / 7 日』榜單前 100 名
And 底部顯示『我的排名』
scenarios.gherkin_en:
Given the player is logged in
When the player taps the Leaderboard entry
Then the default Personal/Bet/7d top 100 is shown
And 'My Rank' is shown at the bottom
scenarios.sequence_diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant G as Gateway
  participant L as Leaderboard Svc
  participant R as Redis
  C->>G: GET /api/v1/leaderboard?category=personal&metric=bet&period=7d
  G->>L: forward
  L->>R: ZREVRANGE lb:personal:bet:7d 0 99
  R-->>L: [...]
  L->>R: ZREVRANK lb:personal:bet:7d {user_id}
  R-->>L: 152
  L-->>G: 200 {list, my}
  G-->>C: 200 OK

scenarios.title: 玩家未上榜時顯示『未上榜』
scenarios.gherkin_zh:
Given 玩家分數未進入前 100
When 玩家進入排行榜
Then 底部『我的排名』顯示『未上榜，再加把勁！』
scenarios.sequence_diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant L as Leaderboard Svc
  participant R as Redis
  C->>L: GET /api/v1/leaderboard
  L->>R: ZREVRANK lb:... {user_id}
  R-->>L: nil
  L-->>C: 200 {list, my: null}

scenarios.title: Redis 失效時退化讀 MongoDB
scenarios.gherkin_zh:
Given Redis 連線失敗
When 玩家拉取排行榜
Then Service 退化讀 MongoDB.leaderboard_snapshots 最新一筆
And 回應夾帶 stale=true 標記
scenarios.sequence_diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant L as Leaderboard Svc
  participant R as Redis
  participant M as MongoDB
  C->>L: GET /api/v1/leaderboard
  L->>R: ZREVRANGE
  R--xL: timeout
  L->>M: find latest snapshot
  M-->>L: snapshot doc
  L-->>C: 200 {list, stale:true}

scenarios.title: 玩家領取週期獎勵成功
scenarios.gherkin_zh:
Given 週期已結算且玩家上榜
When 玩家點擊領獎按鈕
Then 錢包加值
And 顯示獎勵彈窗
scenarios.sequence_diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant L as Leaderboard Svc
  participant R as Redis
  participant M as MongoDB
  C->>L: POST /api/v1/leaderboard/claim
  L->>R: GET claimed:{user}:{period}
  R-->>L: nil
  L->>M: find leaderboard_rewards
  M-->>L: {coins:100000}
  L->>M: wallets +coins (version+1)
  L->>R: SET claimed:{user}:{period} EX 7d
  L-->>C: 200 {reward_coins:100000}

scenarios.title: 重複領取被擋下
scenarios.gherkin_zh:
Given 玩家已領過此週期獎勵
When 玩家再次點擊領獎
Then 回傳 409
And 客戶端顯示『已領取』
scenarios.sequence_diagram:
sequenceDiagram
  participant C as Client
  participant L as Leaderboard Svc
  participant R as Redis
  C->>L: POST /api/v1/leaderboard/claim
  L->>R: GET claimed:{user}:{period}
  R-->>L: "1"
  L-->>C: 409 Already Claimed
